prompt: Hierarchical edge bundling explorer. Layout switcher: circle pack (d3.pack), treemap (d3.treemap), dendrogram, radial tree, sunburst, icicle. Bundle links with curveBundle and tension slider defaulting to 0.85 so bundles are clearly visible. Toggle link visibility and link layer order. Click to select nodes, hover to highlight groups. Randomize dataset button that uses keyed .join() to cross-fade to new data — never call .remove() before rebuilding, always transition existing nodes to new positions, enter new nodes at computed size not zero. Use keyed .join(enter, update, exit) for all layout transitions so nodes interpolate smoothly. Labels: 11px minimum, flip text-anchor at 180° in radial layouts, hide on collision. Control bar: bold section labels, lighter control text.
